status: EXECUTED semantic optimization; MEASURED scoped three-arm comparisons; overall competitive objective NOT YET ACHIEVED

plan.original_corpus: All twelve original sources, inputs and holdouts unchanged; four additional clear-loop compute cases preregistered before timing
plan.comparison: Baseline BBC native v1 frontend/importer versus optimized native frontend, validated v1 boundary, native BF optimizer and v2 importer; unchanged generic XAX verification, host binding and lowering. Pinned brainfry native AOT third arm. JIT and VM not substituted.
plan.pipeline: Complete original source through complete standalone executable, fresh required compiler processes including generic Python bootstrap host for BBC. Baseline and optimized BBC share mapped zero-initialized importer workspace and release it before verification/lowering; this is an explicit external-buffer configuration, not a canonical importer change. Compiler construction, SDK installation and deployment excluded equally.
plan.runtime: Complete standalone process, binary stdin/stdout, exact output and successful exit required. Windows perf_counter_ns around detached CreateProcess/communicate/wait, input-file opening outside; Android native CLOCK_MONOTONIC around fork/exec/output consumption/wait4, pipe/input preparation and ADB outside. No overhead subtraction.
plan.trials: Three independent run clusters, ten timed observations per arm/case/target/run plus warmups. All six arm permutations repeated five times across thirty trials, fixed-seed shuffled. Serial primary jobs. Native-call BBC A/B is separately labeled.
plan.memory: Windows kernel lifetime peak working set queried after exit on retained process handle; each compiler worker has no child tools during measured compilation, so its required process tree has one process. Android child ru_maxrss measured by wait4 in KiB, not PSS. Shared pages and fork/loader floors limit attribution. No sampled resident sum or declared-view-as-RAM inference.
plan.limits: No new real applications, no 20-workload/ten-eligible-per-comparator unrestricted sweep. CPU frequency, thermals, affinity and desktop/device background work uncontrolled. Each scored invocation must pass exact oracle/status. All samples retained; unavailable metrics remain unavailable.

brainfry.flags: --target windows-x86_64 or linux-aarch64; default native AOT optimizations

xax.authority: Native BF frontend/helper and canonical importer libraries; unchanged generic Python bootstrap verifier/reference editor/backends. XAX_REQUIRE_NATIVE unset; no native compiler-host claim.

configuration.measurement_host_policy: Serial primary jobs; normal uncontrolled desktop/device background work. Source/document maintenance performed during trials; no concurrent benchmark jobs, deployment excluded. No affinity/frequency/thermal controls or overhead subtraction.

statistics.estimator: Per-case ratios use arm medians; fixed-corpus aggregates are geometric means of those ratios. Intervals instead estimate paired-log geometric means and are explicitly labeled.
statistics.intervals: 5000 fixed-seed hierarchical bootstrap draws: resample three run clusters, then ten paired observations within each chosen cluster. 95% percentile intervals are exploratory, unadjusted; three clusters sharply limit inference.
statistics.multiplicity: Exact two-sided sign flips of three independent run means; Holm adjustment across all 64 per-case comparisons for each timing metric (16 cases, two targets, two reference arms). With three clusters the smallest two-sided p is 0.25; no confirmatory superiority is claimed.
statistics.memory: Observed OS lifetime high-water counters; no statistical memory victory asserted. Windows peak pagefile remains raw separate data, not job peak commit. Android fork/loader/shared-page floor limits small-program attribution.
statistics.categories: real-decision is the frozen source workload category, not execution inside a real application. No real-app or energy result.

transaction.authority: Unchanged generic Python reference transaction applier, full canonical verifier and Workspace.save; executable changes are canonical graph nodes only.

windows-correctness.bootstrap: Unchanged generic XAX bootstrap verifier/lowerers; native old/new canonical importers; actual standard Brainfuck frontend and optimizer native execution. Python expected_clear is a test oracle only.

independent.scope: Independent C interpreter with Windows binary stdout; agreement and exact consumption; instruction counts are diagnostic, not native benchmark results

conformance.scope: Independent original eight-command interpreter versus both native modes on each target, entire output and tape buffers, immutable input and allocation guards; dirty tape, EOF, five alignments, invalid lengths and first-failure ordering. Nonterminating full-wrap empty bodies only run on zero entry; parity invariants handle nonzero cases.

android-cycles.native_components: Canonical importer and native BF frontend/optimizer on Pixel; Windows-hosted unchanged generic bootstrap verification/lowering only

calibration_excluded.status: PASS native OS lifetime RSS units on touched 16 MiB controls; calibration excluded from scores

limitations: Pinned Brainfry default native AOT only; other competitors/modes retain prior status.
No universal victory; build latency and file size remain behind Brainfry.
CPU frequency, affinity, background work and thermals uncontrolled; thermal dumps retained.

plan.status: Frozen before native-call measurements, after standalone runtime results
plan.scope: All sixteen frozen corpus cases; baseline/optimized BBC only; no competitor score
plan.order: five pairs each order, fixed seed shuffled within run; separate fresh collector/native child process per run
plan.boundary: Every call includes logical length guards, full tape reset and source execution. Per-call clocks summed, validation after each call outside timed interval. Windows includes ctypes call overhead; Android invokes direct function pointers. Two warmup observations per arm. All inputs/outputs and native artifacts frozen before primary process timing.
plan.rationale: Standalone Windows startup dominates; isolate execution costs without replacing process or full-build results.

native_call_comparison.scope: BBC baseline/optimized only; not a competitor score. Native memory initialization/reset stays inside each call; clocks and ctypes overhead described in the plan.
